title: The Forecheck Drill
source_article_title: The Forecheck Drill and Boucher Drill
notes: Forechecking side works on pressure, reads, puck recovery and winning possession.
Breakout side works on support, outlets and escaping pressure under game-like resistance.

title: Boucher Drill
source_article_title: The Forecheck Drill and Boucher Drill
notes: Offensive attack-options drill focused on zone entries.
Develops multiple entry and attack choices rather than one fixed route.
Use it to reinforce support, spacing and reading the available option as the rush develops.
